notes.title: Cooking Fest Game Update
notes.content:
為了慶祝烹飪節，為遊戲帶來加強遊戲體驗的更新!

[list]
[*] Added labels to product ingredients
[*] Improved visibility of drink cup contents labeling
[*] Automatic calibration for item drop direction
[*] Adjusted store layout and item placement
[*] More varied and orderly customers
[*] Added a clearer store management system
[*] Added customer reviews

[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43765647/3df544dca9234c88f773f9082a5f856fbdc48e77.png[/img]

notes.title: "Tea Shop Simulator" will be releasing free demo on 5/12!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43765647/af2c43d5eaacc818dfa0b7c6f71ad6dffacc3a45.png[/img]
Hi Everyone! After long waits, the game has finally be polished, and to join the next fest,
we decided to release the public free demo early for everyone on 5/12!
The game contains hilarious physics and boba tea making process for you to experience!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43765647/a043e61077c01652edead0680b435cf658b3a0cd.png[/img]
While playing, bug could be encountered, therefore we would greatly appreciate if you could report it back to us so we can make the game better than ever!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43765647/dc9884c0de44624f6994859e497f768eafbacce9.png[/img]
The following video is a brand new trailer for the game that introduces various mechanics of the game.
[/previewyoutube][previewyoutube=jAIFVKaZ4Ag;full][/previewyoutube]
Wish eveyone a good weekend and have fun!

by DANGO
